top_liked.author: @kimberlyslone9069
top_liked.text: It was hard for me to let go of all the things I was taught as a child. It wasn’t until I read the Bible in its entirety that I began to question a lot of things. What I was being “told” was not what I was reading.    Keep ripping the band-Aid off…😊
